title: Web console epic P6: package + secure — dist entrypoint, one-click launcher, /console command, docs, security review, release
description:
EPIC "Agentic OS web console" — P6 capstone: make the console installable/launchable by a NON-TECHNICAL user and harden it for release.

Deliverables:
1. ONE-CLICK LAUNCHER (the no-terminal requirement): a frictionless way to start the console without typing commands — e.g. a double-clickable launcher (a .cmd on Windows + a .sh on macOS/Linux, or an npm script the /console command runs) that starts the board/console server bound to 127.0.0.1 and opens the default browser at the URL. After this one click the user lives entirely in buttons + chat. Document the exact launch path for a non-technical user in the README.
2. LAUNCH COMMAND: a plugin slash command (e.g. /agentic-framework:console) that starts the console for users already inside Claude Code, mirroring how /task-status launches the board. (commands/ entry; parity with existing command conventions.)
3. PACKAGING: ensure the console ships in the bundle pipeline — if a new entrypoint exists it joins scripts/build-plugin.mjs ENTRYPOINT_NAMES and dist/ is rebuilt (TASK-049 dist-parity gate must pass). Keep the "nothing to install" promise: served HTML is inline/zero-dep; the only runtime prerequisite is the `claude` CLI the user already has.
4. SECURITY REVIEW: because the console spawns the orchestrator (which can mutate files + run skills/subagents) and exposes chat + run-immediately skill buttons on a local port, run a focused security pass: confirm the Host allowlist covers all new routes, the session-id and skill-id guards reject abuse, no arbitrary command string is executable from the client, the body caps hold, and document the trust model (local-only, single-user, reuses existing login) plus residual risks in the README/SECURITY note.
5. DOCS: README section for the non-technical operator: what the console is, the one-click launch, and the honest note that usage counts against their existing Claude plan (no NEW cost, but not free of plan usage).
6. RELEASE: bump the plugin version at BOTH pin sites (.claude-plugin/plugin.json + tests/publish-config.spec.js EXPECTED_VERSION), run the full release gate (npm run test:all + claude plugin validate), and tag — this epic is a coherent minor version bump. (Human approval required before tagging/pushing per Principle #4.)

verification_tier tests-after for the code seams (launcher script presence/shape, command file parity, version-pin consistency, ENTRYPOINT_NAMES coverage) + manual/UAT for the live launch and the security walkthrough. This is a release/packaging ticket touching publish config + test infra → the FULL test:all gate applies. UAT: a non-technical-style launch (double-click → browser opens to the console), the /console command launch, and a security walkthrough of the new routes.
acceptance_criteria: A one-click launcher exists (double-clickable .cmd + .sh, or an equivalent the /console command runs) that starts the console on 127.0.0.1 and opens the browser, requiring NO typed commands from the user; the README documents the exact non-technical launch path.
A plugin slash command (e.g. /agentic-framework:console) launches the console from within Claude Code, following the existing command conventions (commands/ entry, parity-checked like the others).

If a new bundled entrypoint exists it is added to scripts/build-plugin.mjs ENTRYPOINT_NAMES and dist/ is rebuilt so the TASK-049 dist-parity gate passes; the served console remains zero-dep/inline (nothing for the user to install beyond the `claude` CLI they already have).

A focused security review is recorded: Host allowlist covers ALL new routes, session-id + skill-id guards reject abuse, the client cannot execute an arbitrary command string, body caps hold; the trust model (local-only, single-user, reuses existing login) and residual risks are documented.
README gains a non-technical-operator section: what the console is, the one-click launch, and the honest 'no NEW cost but counts against your existing plan' note.

Release gate: version bumped at BOTH pin sites (.claude-plugin/plugin.json + tests/publish-config.spec.js EXPECTED_VERSION), npm run test:all green, claude plugin validate PASS, and the tag/push performed only after explicit human approval; a UAT covering the double-click launch, the /console command, and the security walkthrough is recorded with all steps PASS.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Plan + tier: tests-after for the code seams + MANUAL/UAT for live launch + a dedicated SECURITY REVIEW pass. This is a release/packaging ticket touching publish config → FULL test:all gate. Sequencing: (1) DEV build phase (this spawn): one-click launcher (console.cmd + console.sh at repo root) that starts the console server on 127.0.0.1 and opens the browser — no typed commands; commands/console.md slash command (mirror commands/task-status.md, framed as the full OS console); README non-technical-operator section + the honest 'no NEW cost but counts against your existing Agent-SDK plan credit' note + a documented trust model (local-only, single-user, reuses existing login) & residual risks; version bump 0.4.0→0.5.0 at BOTH pins (.claude-plugin/plugin.json + tests/publish-config.spec.js EXPECTED_VERSION). The console is already dist/task-board.cjs (in ENTRYPOINT_NAMES + shipped-bin) so no new bundle entry — but rebuild dist if any bundled source changes. Locks (tests-after): launcher files exist + reference the server entry + a 127.0.0.1 URL; commands/console.md parity with command conventions; version-pin consistency at both sites. DO NOT tag or push — the release tag/push is a separate human-approved gate (Principle #4). (2) Then I run an independent SECURITY REVIEW (reviewer, fresh context) across ALL new routes (chat/skill/create/session) + a general review. (3) Then the LIVE UAT + release gate WITH the human — this is where ALL deferred live legs (real streamed reply, click-runs-skill, board-updates-on-chat, status-tracks-work, double-click launch) get exercised in one live launch, then claude plugin validate + tag/push on explicit approval.

comments.author: reviewer
comments.body:
RELEASE-CAPSTONE REVIEW (security + diff) — APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOWUPS, 0 HIGH / 0 MEDIUM / 1 LOW / 2 NIT. test:all 734 passed/5 skipped, dist-parity GREEN, claude plugin validate PASS. SAFE TO SHIP as a local-only single-user tool: YES.
SECURITY (AC4) — Host guard enforced ONCE before routing (ALLOWED_HOST_RE 127.0.0.1|localhost) so ALL new routes inherit it. Per-route audit all SAFE: POST /api/chat/:sessionId (415/413, SESSION_ID_RE, message→JSON stdin frame to claude child, never exec'd/no shell), GET .../stream + POST .../stop (id-guarded, %-decode-guarded), POST .../skill (skillId→server-mapped via resolveSkillInvocation, unknown→400 no send — no client command string), GET /api/skills (omits raw invocation), POST /api/tasks (415/413, validated, delegates to createTask atomic write, no path-join), GET /api/session (read-only bounded, never 500). No-API-key spawn intact (buildChildEnv strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY+ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, no shell:true). --open opens a FIXED server-derived 127.0.0.1 URL (not client input), try/catch best-effort, stdio:ignore, unref, argv-array (no shell:true) — cannot crash the server or inject args. Trust model documented in README + commands/console.md (local-only, reuses login, no new key/bill but counts against plan Agent-SDK credit, skill buttons run immediately → trusted machine only). No HIGH/MEDIUM security gaps.
DIFF — AC1-AC5 PASS (launcher console.cmd/console.sh → dist/task-board.cjs --open --port 4517; --open/openBrowser locked non-vacuously; /console command parity; README non-technical + cost + trust; version 0.5.0 at BOTH pins). AC6 PASS for pre-tag scope (version consistent, test:all green, plugin validate PASS). LOW: console-launch.spec version-pin assertion duplicates publish-config.spec (cosmetic). NIT: console.md correctly omits panel_safe (won't appear as a one-click button); README web-console paragraph is dense (future bullet pass). REMAINING (human-gated, not code): live UAT (double-click launch + /console + the deferred live legs) recorded as uat comment, then tag/push on explicit approval.
